correctness.rationale: Finite-field ratio x=−α² gives the exact divisibility rank for odd p. Odd-index LTE yields p^{c+v_p(k)}, and direct Möbius convolution gives four nonzero transform families; their denominators prove the optimal repair factor and the negative 2r transform. Frobenius at inert primes distinguishes p mod 4, and independent nontrivial real/imaginary quadratic characters yield exact bad-prime density 1/4. The 2-adic recurrence congruence settles p=2. An exact integer verifier checks 140 parameter-prime cases through index 120 and 16,800 Möbius sums, as corroboration not proof.
